name: DreamOS Chromium (vanilla 156 content layer; forge-shell)
script:
set -x
# DreamOS's browser work (docs/forge-shell.md in DreamScape/DreamOS): VANILLA Chromium 156.0.8078.79 content layer, no Alchemy patches.
# Today the image ships Debian's chromium package; this pipeline is the toolchain proof (content_shell, as the dreamos-build VM's ~/chromium/build-cs.sh)
# and, once src/dreamos/forge_shell exists (FORGE_PATCH=<dir of the DreamOS repo with the GN target>), builds forge_shell. Checkout + ccache live on the pipeline's LV (/cache).
git config --global --add safe.directory '*'
mkdir -p /cache/chromium /cache/ccache && cd /cache/chromium
export CCACHE_DIR=/cache/ccache CCACHE_BASEDIR=/cache/chromium/src CCACHE_COMPILERCHECK=content CCACHE_SLOPPINESS=time_macros CCACHE_MAXSIZE=60G
export DEPOT_TOOLS_UPDATE=0 PATH=/opt/depot_tools:$PATH
V=$(sed -n 's/^MAJOR=//p;s/^MINOR=//p;s/^BUILD=//p;s/^PATCH=//p' src/chrome/VERSION 2>/dev/null | paste -sd.)
if [ "$V" != "$TAG" ]; then
  [ -f .gclient ] || gclient config --spec 'solutions=[{"name":"src","url":"https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src.git","managed":False,"custom_deps":{},"custom_vars":{"checkout_nacl":False,"checkout_pgo_profiles":False}}]'
  nice -n 19 gclient sync --nohooks --no-history --shallow --revision "src@refs/tags/$TAG" -j10
  (cd src && build/install-build-deps.sh --help >/dev/null 2>&1 || true); nice -n 19 gclient runhooks
fi
cd src
TARGET=${TARGET:-content_shell}
if [ -n "${FORGE_SRC:-}" ] && [ -d /work/src/chromium/dreamos ]; then rm -rf dreamos && cp -r /work/src/chromium/dreamos dreamos; TARGET=forge_shell; fi
mkdir -p out/forge && cat > out/forge/args.gn <<ARGS
is_debug = false
symbol_level = 0
blink_symbol_level = 0
v8_symbol_level = 0
enable_nacl = false
use_ozone = true
ozone_platform_x11 = false
ozone_platform_wayland = true
ozone_auto_platforms = false
use_cups = false
proprietary_codecs = false
treat_warnings_as_errors = false
chrome_pgo_phase = 0
use_remoteexec = false
use_siso = false
cc_wrapper = "ccache"
ARGS
gn gen out/forge
echo "[rack] chromium $TAG target $TARGET jobs ${JOBS:-80} start $(date -Is)"
autoninja -C out/forge -j "${JOBS:-80}" $TARGET
ccache -s || true
mkdir -p /out && tar -C out/forge -czf /out/dreamos-$TARGET-$TAG.tar.gz --exclude='*.runtime_deps' --exclude=obj --exclude=gen --exclude='*.ninja*' $(cd out/forge && ls | grep -E "^($TARGET|content_shell|forge_shell)$|\.pak$|\.so$|\.bin$|\.dat$|locales|icudtl|v8_context_snapshot" )
(cd /out && sha256sum dreamos-$TARGET-$TAG.tar.gz > dreamos-$TARGET-$TAG.tar.gz.sha256)
echo "[rack] end $(date -Is)"
